patch_list: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.
Changes the accent color. Choose a color in the patches menu.
Adds settings to hide the Spread the word section, the Discover Proton section and the Proton Pass banner.
Shows the pull to refresh indicator as the Material 3 Expressive shape-morphing loading indicator.
Adds check and close icons to switches.
